title: The next episode is one click away | kurtz
description:
kurtz shows the next episode’s number and title, then starts it with one click. This recording uses the explicitly named Open Cinema Stories demo library, assembled from licensed Blender clips. The dark first background is the real paused end-of-episode frame; the actual Next Episode control is magnified for readability.

kurtz for macOS · Beta. Local files work without a Jellyfin server. Jellyfin features require your server; episode prompts depend on available chapters/segments and metadata. VLC is the default local playback engine; compatibility depends on the file.
Discover kurtz: https://ralleur.github.io/kurtz/

Demo films: Sintel © Blender Foundation / durian.blender.org and Big Buck Bunny © 2008 Blender Foundation / www.bigbuckbunny.org (CC BY 3.0). Library artwork also includes Caminandes: Gran Dillama © Caminandes team / Blender Foundation, (CC) caminandes.com (CC BY-SA 3.0). Film excerpts cropped/resized. Music: original Ralleur production, existing hauser-D / hauser-F masters; source-film audio removed. Built on Swiftfin: https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin . kurtz is independent of Jellyfin, Swiftfin and the filmmakers.
